verdict.rationale: Archive extraction and repacking is a fair question for a cloud file converter, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never mentions ZIP, 7z, RAR or any archive converter. The generic '300 formats' claim and the listed converter categories (image, presentation, font, ebook) do not show archive extract/repack as part of a conversion.

support.subject: As a power user, archives (ZIP, 7z, RAR) extract and repack as part of a conversion
